summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a commercial psilocybin export to Australia for treatment-resistant depression. This is a routine operational and regulatory update, not a special situation. It describes the third shipment of 5mg psilocybin capsules, noting the regulatory framework and reimbursement coverage. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard business progress report with no special-situation event.
